sources.title: Types of model-driven app forms in Power Apps
Properties available in the form designer
Add and configure a subgrid component on a form
Create a quick view form to view information about a related table
Add and configure a quick view component on a form
How model-driven app main forms appear on different devices
Understand dashboards: Dashboard components and FormXML
Behavior and format of the date and time column
Create a business rule for a table
Create business rules to apply logic in a model-driven app form
Sdk Message Processing Step (SdkMessageProcessingStep) table/entity reference
How to create and modify Dataverse forms by using the Data workspace
Configure basic form metadata for portals
Configure notes as attachments for basic and multistep forms
Create and modify Dataverse views by using the Data workspace
Missing dependencies error during solution import
Use file column data in Microsoft Dataverse

items.name: Main form
items.notes: Only main forms can be deactivated (FormActivationState 0/1). Power Pages basic and multistep forms render a Dataverse form by Table + Form Name; the Data workspace Forms tab only shows the main form type, described as the type supported in portals.

items.name: Quick create form
items.notes: Optimized for creating new records in model-driven apps. Power Pages Data workspace lists only main forms; consumption by basic forms is not documented.

items.name: Quick view form
items.where: SystemForm.Type=6; <forms type="quick">; embedded via quick view control on a main form
items.notes: Read-only, no form scripts, no header/footer/navigation, no security roles or activation, no custom controls. Power Pages rendering of quick view controls is not documented on the cited pages.

items.name: Card form
items.where: SystemForm with card type (type code not listed on cited Learn page)
items.notes: Compact presentation used in views for model-driven apps. Not consumed by Power Pages per Data workspace (main only).

items.name: Mobile form
items.notes: Legacy mobile form type listed among SystemForm.Type values.

items.name: Dashboard
items.notes: Dashboards are a form type; only a subset of FormXML is supported. Not a Power Pages record form.

items.name: Form activation state
items.notes: Only main forms can be deactivated.

items.name: Power Pages basic form mode over a Dataverse form
items.where: Basic form Mode = Insert | Edit | ReadOnly; Record Source Type = Query String | Current Portal User | Record Associated to Current Portal User
items.notes: Edit/ReadOnly need a source record. Optional Tab Name renders a single tab; Auto Generate Steps From Tabs renders tabs as sequential steps. Business rules, duplicate fields and party list fields are not supported in basic forms; connection-table subgrids are not supported; hidden choice values are not supported.

items.name: Power Pages multistep form step over a Dataverse form
items.where: Multistep form step (Load Form / Load Tab step types)
items.notes: Each step behaves like a basic form; rollup columns may render editable unless the Dataverse form marks them read-only.

items.name: <form> root
items.where: FormXml <form shownavigationbar maxWidth>; children tabs, header, footer, events, formLibraries, Navigation, hiddencontrols, controlDescriptions, formparameters, DisplayConditions
items.notes: Designer Max Width defaults to 1900 px. Show image displays the table primary image in the header.

items.name: Tab
items.where: <tab id name expanded visible showlabel verticallayout locklevel availableforphone><labels/><columns/>
items.notes: Designer: "Expand this tab by default", "Hide tab" (shown via code), "Hide on phone", layout up to three columns.

items.name: Tab column
items.notes: Tabs have up to three columns with percentage widths.

items.name: Section
items.where: <section id name showlabel showbar visible columns labelwidth celllabelalignment celllabelposition locklevel availableforphone height layout>
items.notes: Designer allows up to four columns. celllabelposition enum Top|Left; celllabelalignment enum Center|Left|Right.

items.name: Row
items.notes: Rows contain cells; header/footer use the same row/cell structure.

items.name: Cell
items.where: <cell id auto showlabel colspan rowspan visible userspacer ispreviewcell locklevel availableforphone><labels/><control/><events/></cell>
items.notes: Designer column properties: Label, Hide label, Read-only, Lock, Hide, Hide on phone, Form field width (number of section columns occupied).

items.name: Control
items.where: <control id classid datafieldname uniqueid labelid disabled isunbound isrequired relationship indicationOfSubgrid><parameters/></control>
items.notes: datafieldname binds to a column logical name; disabled="true" is the read-only/locked state on the form.

items.name: Localized label
items.notes: Per-language label text for tabs, sections, cells.

items.name: Subgrid
items.notes: Designer: Show related records, Table, Default view, Allow users to change view, Show all views, Hide search box (quick find), Maximum number of rows 2-250. Power Pages renders an embedded subgrid read-only; create/associate/download/row actions need Basic Form Metadata type Subgrid keyed by subgrid Name, and table permissions.

items.name: Quick view control
items.where: <control> with <parameters><QuickForms/></parameters> bound to a lookup on the main form
items.notes: Shows the related record selected in a lookup using that table's quick view form. Power Pages behavior not documented on cited pages.

items.name: IFRAME
items.notes: Displaying a table form inside an IFRAME on another table form is not supported.

items.name: Web resource
items.notes: Power Pages basic form option "Render Web Resources Inline" removes the wrapping iframe.

items.name: Spacer
items.notes: Only the userspacer cell attribute is in the schema; Learn has no prose description.

items.name: Timeline / notes control
items.where: Timeline control on the Dataverse form; Power Pages Basic Form Metadata Type=Notes/Timeline
items.notes: Notes appear in Power Pages only when the note text starts with *WEB* (KnowledgeManagement/NotesFilter site setting). Edit/delete limited to the note creator; annotation child table permissions required.

items.name: Header
items.notes: Header layout is rows/cells. Quick view forms have no header.

items.name: Footer
items.notes: Same structure as header.

items.name: Hidden controls
items.notes: Columns carried by the form without visible controls.

items.name: Form events and libraries
items.where: <formLibraries><Library name libraryUniqueId/></formLibraries><events><event name application attribute><Handlers><Handler functionName libraryName passExecutionContext enabled/></Handlers></event></events>
items.notes: Model-driven client script registration. Power Pages uses basic form Custom JavaScript; execution of model-driven handlers in Power Pages is not documented.

items.name: Form navigation
items.notes: Related-record navigation items.

items.name: Custom (code component) control binding
items.notes: Field-level code components can be added to Power Pages forms.

items.name: Power Pages tab/section label override
items.where: Basic Form Metadata Type=Tab|Section with Tab Name / Section Name + Label
items.notes: Replaces the Dataverse tab or section label per language.

items.name: Power Pages attach file control
items.where: Basic form Additional Settings: Attach File, Storage Location, Allow Multiple, Accept, Required, Max size
items.notes: Rendered at the bottom of the basic form; stored as note attachments or Azure Blob.

items.name: Single line text control
items.where: <control classid datafieldname> bound to StringType; parameters MaxLength, IsPassword, Format
items.notes: FormatName selects text, email, URL, phone, ticker, text area, rich text or JSON presentation. Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: Multiline text control
items.where: <control> bound to MemoType; parameters MaxLength, Height
items.notes: Rows configurable on the column. Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: Whole number control
items.where: <control> bound to IntegerType; parameters MinValue, MaxValue, Format
items.notes: Format None/Duration/TimeZone/Language/Locale changes the editor. Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: Decimal control
items.where: <control> bound to DecimalType; parameters MinValue, MaxValue, Precision
items.notes: Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: Floating point control
items.where: <control> bound to DoubleType; parameters MinValue, MaxValue, Precision
items.notes: Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: Currency control
items.where: <control> bound to MoneyType; parameters MinValue, MaxValue, Precision
items.notes: Precision source from column, organization pricing precision or record currency. Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: Date and time control
items.notes: Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: Choice control
items.where: <control> bound to PicklistType/StateType/StatusType; parameters OptionSetId, DefaultValue
items.notes: Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: Choices (multi-select) control
items.notes: Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: Yes/No control
items.notes: Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: Lookup control
items.where: <control> bound to LookupType/CustomerType/OwnerType; parameters DefaultViewId, AvailableViewIds, DisableMru, DisableQuickFind, DisableViewPicker, FilterRelationshipName, DependentAttributeName, DependentAttributeType, AllowFilterOff, TargetEntities, AutoResolve
items.notes: Power Pages: a lookup rendered as a dropdown ignores the related-records filter. Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: Image control
items.notes: Not supported on Power Pages GenAI forms. Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: File control
items.notes: Upload/delete happens immediately in model-driven apps. Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: Subgrid control
items.notes: See dv.formxml.subgrid. Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: Quick view control
items.notes: See dv.formxml.quick-view. Learn does not enumerate control classid GUIDs; read the classid from the exported FormXml control.

items.name: Single line of text (Text format)
items.notes: Default length 100, max 4,000 characters. Reducing max length does not truncate existing data.

items.name: Single line of text (Text Area format)
items.notes: Multiple lines, default 100, max 4,000.

items.name: Single line of text (Email format)
items.notes: Validated as an e-mail address; mailto link.

items.name: Single line of text (URL format)
items.notes: Displayed as a link.

items.name: Single line of text (Phone format)
items.notes: Link to start a call.

items.name: Single line of text (Ticker Symbol format)
items.notes: Not supported on Power Pages GenAI forms.

items.name: Text (Rich text format)
items.notes: Rendered with the rich text control. Can be secured; embedded images cannot be masked.

items.name: Text (JSON format)
items.where: StringAttributeMetadata FormatName=Json; Memo Json only for non-SQL data provider

items.name: Single line of text (VersionNumber, internal)
items.notes: Internal use only.

items.name: Autonumber (string with AutoNumberFormat)
items.notes: Value is assigned on save; Unified Interface controls bound to autonumber columns should be explicitly disabled. RANDSTRING length 1-6; SEQNUM is a minimum length, default seed 1000; SetAutoNumberSeed changes the next value; seeds are not carried by solutions; gaps possible.

items.name: Multiple lines of text
items.notes: Default 150, max 1,048,576 characters.

items.name: Whole number (None format)
items.notes: Text box.

items.name: Whole number (Duration format)
items.notes: Dropdown of intervals; stores minutes.

items.name: Whole number (Time zone format)
items.notes: Dropdown of time zones.

items.name: Whole number (Language format)
items.notes: Dropdown of enabled languages; stores LCID. Business rules do not support Language columns.

items.name: Whole number (Locale format)
items.notes: Listed in the Format/FormatName table; IntegerFormat.Locale = 4 is a documented IntegerAttributeMetadata.Format value (learn-integerformat), so it is settable through the metadata API.

items.name: Decimal number
items.notes: Stored exactly. Browser apps handle about 15 significant digits precisely.

items.name: Floating point number
items.notes: Approximate storage.

items.name: Currency
items.notes: First currency column adds a currency lookup and a read-only exchange rate; each currency column adds a read-only <name>_base column. Specific precision 0-4.

items.name: Big integer
items.notes: Max 9,223,372,036,854,775,807; not supported in canvas and model-driven apps; used for Time Stamp.

items.name: Date and time (User local behavior)
items.notes: Stored UTC, displayed in user time zone. Default for Date and time format. Can be changed once to DateOnly/TimeZoneIndependent unless CanChangeDateTimeBehavior=false. Avoid DateOnly format with UserLocal.

items.name: Date only behavior
items.notes: No time stored; operators Older Than X Minutes/Hours and Last/Next X Hours are invalid. Business rules treat DateOnly values as UTC.

items.name: Date and time (Time zone independent behavior)
items.notes: No time-zone conversion; default behavior for the Date only format in the maker UI.

items.name: Date and time display format
items.notes: Format affects display only; time can still be set through the API when behavior is not DateOnly. Values from 1/1/1753.

items.name: Choice (local option set)
items.where: PicklistAttributeMetadata with OptionSet defined in the column
items.notes: Options defined in the column.

items.name: Choice (global option set)
items.where: PicklistAttributeMetadata OptionSet referencing a global choice
items.notes: Shared options. Power Pages does not support hidden choice values.

items.name: Choices (multi-select)
items.notes: Not usable in business rules, workflows, BPF, charts, rollup/calculated columns. Query with contain-values / not-contain-values. Not sortable.

items.name: Status (statecode)
items.notes: Custom tables have Active/Inactive only. Cannot be column-secured.

items.name: Status reason (statuscode)
items.where: StatusAttributeMetadata (StatusType); each option maps to a state
items.notes: Supports custom status reason transitions.

items.name: Lookup (simple)
items.notes: N:1 relationship; the target primary name is returned even without read access to it. Lookups cannot be column-secured.

items.name: Customer
items.notes: Always searchable; not sortable.

items.name: Owner
items.notes: System lookup on user/team owned tables.

items.name: Multi-table (polymorphic) lookup
items.where: LookupAttributeMetadata Targets=[several tables] (custom multi-table or Regarding)
items.notes: Custom multi-table lookups are created with code.

items.name: Party list
items.notes: System-only; not supported in Power Pages basic forms; not searchable or sortable.

items.name: Image
items.notes: Max size default 10,240 KB, range 1-30,720 KB; stored as jpg with a 144x144 thumbnail; one primary image per table. Not usable in business rules, BPF, charts, rollup/calculated (types-of-columns). Can be secured, not masked.

items.name: File
items.notes: Default 32 MB, designer max 131,072 KB, fixed after save. Required validation does not work; not usable in business rules, BPF, charts, rollup/calculated.

items.name: Unique identifier
items.notes: Primary key GUID; not supported in business rules.

items.name: Calculated column
items.notes: Read-only; computed as system so secured inputs can leak; supported on Boolean, DateTime, Decimal, String, Integer, Money, Picklist.

items.name: Rollup column
items.notes: Calculated asynchronously (hourly by default); CalculateRollupField on demand. Not supported in business rules. Power Pages may render rollups editable unless the form control is read-only.

items.name: Formula (Power Fx) column
items.notes: Evaluated on fetch; not searchable or sortable; cannot be column-secured.

items.name: Prompt column
items.notes: AI prompt result stored in a string column.

items.name: Entity name (internal)
items.notes: Internal use.

items.name: Virtual
items.notes: Cannot be used in code.

items.name: Managed property
items.notes: Solution component customizability flags.

items.name: Required level SystemRequired
items.notes: Enforced by Dataverse only for system columns; custom columns cannot use it.

items.name: Required level ApplicationRequired (Business Required)
items.notes: Enforced by model-driven apps, not by the Dataverse API. Power Pages basic forms can force all fields required ("Make All Fields Required").

items.name: Required level Recommended
items.notes: Power Pages option "Set Recommended Fields as Required" upgrades these to required.

items.name: Operation validity flags
items.where: AttributeMetadata IsValidForCreate, IsValidForUpdate, IsValidForRead, IsValidForForm, IsRequiredForForm
items.notes: Values set on invalid operations are ignored; invalid reads return null. IsValidForUpdate=false makes the column read-only after create.

items.name: Locked/read-only on form
items.notes: Business rules/client API can unlock locked fields even on a read-only form.

items.name: Hidden on form
items.notes: Hidden by default; can be shown with code or a business rule.

items.name: Default values
items.where: Column mapping (InitializeFrom), business rule Set Default Value, control parameter DefaultValue
items.notes: Mapped values from a parent record pre-fill new related records.

items.name: Maximum length
items.notes: Text 4,000 / memo 1,048,576 maxima.

items.name: Minimum and maximum values
items.where: Integer/Decimal/Double/Money MinValue, MaxValue; control parameters MinValue, MaxValue
items.notes: MinValue/MaxValue appear in Learn table reference metadata (e.g. Rank) and as FormXml parameters.

items.name: Column security enabled
items.notes: Users without profile access see a lock and asterisks; secured columns cannot be part of an alternate key.

items.name: Searchable / sortable flags
items.notes: Formula, image and party list cannot be searchable; choices, customer, file, formula, image and party list cannot be sortable.

items.name: Scope Entity (table)
items.notes: Applies to all model-driven forms and the server. The table article FAQ also says rules run on clients and are not executed inside Dataverse; its limits note says server-side rules are XAML generated as synchronous plugins.

items.name: Scope All Forms
items.notes: Model-driven forms only.

items.name: Scope specific form
items.notes: Only that form; main and quick create forms.

items.name: Condition
items.where: Condition component with rules combined AND/OR; source Entity field compared to value, field or formula
items.notes: Every rule starts with a condition; actions attach to the true or false branch. Referenced fields must be on the form for form execution.

items.name: Set field value
items.where: Set Field Value action (value, other field, simple formula)
items.notes: All scopes.

items.name: Clear field value
items.where: Set Field Value action with clear
items.notes: All scopes.

items.name: Set default value
items.notes: Only when the column is null. All scopes.

items.name: Show error message
items.where: Show Error Message action on a field
items.notes: Prevents save; server-side the message is returned to the caller. Localizable labels.

items.name: Lock / unlock
items.notes: Model-driven only; ignored server-side; can unlock fields on a read-only form.

items.name: Set visibility
items.notes: Model-driven only; ignored server-side; not available in canvas apps.

items.name: Set business required
items.notes: Business Required or Not Business Required; model-driven only.

items.name: Recommendation
items.notes: Light bulb next to the label; accepting applies set-value actions. Model-driven only.

items.name: Business rule storage
items.where: workflow (process) record Category=2 (Business Rule); Xaml column; ClientData column ("Business logic converted into client data"); StateCode activation
items.notes: Must be deactivated to edit. Up to 150 rules per table recommended (client JavaScript and server XAML).

items.name: Unsupported column types
items.notes: Not supported: multi-select choices, file, language, unique identifier, rollup, localizable-value columns, composite columns (fullname/address).

items.name: Execution timing
items.notes: Rules run before onLoad scripts and do not react to onLoad changes; run on form open and field change; not retroactive on existing records.

items.name: Business rules in Power Pages basic forms
items.notes: Not supported in basic forms; locked fields may be enabled on read-only forms by business rules/client API.

items.name: View query type 0: Public (MainApplicationView)
items.notes: Many; set one default with IsDefault.

items.name: View query type 1: Advanced Find (AdvancedSearch)
items.notes: One; update only.

items.name: View query type 2: Associated (SubGrid)
items.notes: One; default related-records grid.

items.name: View query type 4: Quick Find (QuickFindSearch)
items.notes: One; defines searched columns.

items.name: View query type 16: Offline filters
items.notes: Outlook offline.

items.name: View query type 64: Lookup (LookupView)
items.notes: One; default lookup view when none is configured.

items.name: View query type 128: Service management appointment book
View query type 512: Address book filters
View query type 1024: Main application view without subject
View query type 2048: Saved query type other (workflow/email templates)
View query type 4096: Interactive workflow (dialog) view
View query type 16384: Custom defined view
View query type 65536: Export field translations view
View query type: Copilot view
items.notes: Listed without a value.

items.name: layoutxml grid
items.where: <grid name="resultset" object jump select preview icon><row name="result" id="<primary key>">
items.notes: jump names the primary/link column; select/preview/icon flags.

items.name: layoutxml cell (column)
items.notes: Linked-entity columns use alias.attribute names. Icon provider only for read-only grids.

items.name: fetchxml attributes
items.notes: Columns retrieved for the view.

items.name: fetchxml filter
items.notes: Power Pages enhanced view filter replaces condition values with the current contact (uitype="contact"), parent account (uitype="account") or website (uitype="adx_website").

items.name: fetchxml link-entity
items.where: <link-entity name from to alias link-type="outer|inner" visible>
items.notes: Related columns appear in layoutxml as alias.attribute.

items.name: Default public view
items.notes: Only one active public view can be default; the default view cannot be deactivated.

items.name: View active/inactive
items.notes: State is not exported with solutions; imported views are active. Deactivation is an Update of StateCode 1/StatusCode 2; a default public view cannot be deactivated (learn-customize-views).

items.name: Other SavedQuery definition columns
items.where: ColumnSetXml, LayoutJson, ConditionalFormatting, AdvancedGroupBy, RoleDisplayConditionsXml, ReturnedTypeCode, IsCustomizable

items.name: Power Pages list over views
items.where: Power Pages list with one or more SavedQuery views
items.notes: Multiple views render a dropdown; Data workspace shows only view types supported in portals; filters by portal user / parent account attribute.

items.name: Power Pages basic form subgrid view
items.where: Form subgrid view + Basic Form Metadata Type=Subgrid
items.notes: Read-only unless metadata actions are configured; the associate action needs a view.

items.name: Stage 10 PreValidation
items.notes: Before the transaction and before security checks; best place to cancel.

items.name: Stage 20 PreOperation
items.notes: In transaction; change Target values here; cancelling rolls back.

items.name: Stage 40 PostOperation
items.notes: In transaction when synchronous; only stage allowing asynchronous mode.

items.name: Internal stages
items.notes: Internal use; MainOperation (30) only for custom API / virtual table providers.

items.name: Execution mode
items.notes: Async goes to the system job queue after the operation.

items.name: Message Create
items.where: SdkMessageProcessingStep.SdkMessageId -> sdkmessage Create; SdkMessageFilterId selects the primary entity
items.notes: Supports entity images (Create: no pre image; Delete: no post image).

items.name: Message Update
items.where: SdkMessageProcessingStep.SdkMessageId -> sdkmessage Update; SdkMessageFilterId selects the primary entity
items.notes: Supports filtering attributes and pre/post images; may fire twice for specialized updates.

items.name: Message Delete
items.where: SdkMessageProcessingStep.SdkMessageId -> sdkmessage Delete; SdkMessageFilterId selects the primary entity
items.notes: Supports entity images (Create: no pre image; Delete: no post image).

items.name: Message Retrieve
items.where: SdkMessageProcessingStep.SdkMessageId -> sdkmessage Retrieve; SdkMessageFilterId selects the primary entity
items.notes: Without a primary entity the step runs for all entities supporting the message. No entity images.

items.name: Message RetrieveMultiple
items.where: SdkMessageProcessingStep.SdkMessageId -> sdkmessage RetrieveMultiple; SdkMessageFilterId selects the primary entity
items.notes: Without a primary entity the step runs for all entities supporting the message. No entity images.

items.name: Filtering attributes
items.notes: Fires when any listed column is in the request, changed or not; never include the primary key.

items.name: Entity images
items.where: SdkMessageProcessingStepImage pre/post with alias and attributes
items.notes: Post image only in PostOperation; Update in PostOperation can have both. Select only needed columns.

items.name: Execution order
items.notes: Lowest first; equal ranks have undefined order.

items.name: Run in user context
items.notes: Default is the calling user.

items.name: InvalidPluginExecutionException
items.notes: Any exception in a synchronous in-transaction stage rolls back the whole transaction; throw with a message (ideally in PreValidation) to cancel and return it to the caller.

items.name: Step configuration
items.notes: Secure configuration is not exported in solutions.

items.name: Invocation source
items.notes: Picklist, SystemRequired, DefaultFormValue 0 (learn-sdkstep-table). Read the effective value back from the step record or the exported step XML; it is not inferred from registration input.

items.name: Column security profile
items.where: Column (field) security profile with users/teams and per-column permissions
items.notes: Organization-wide; system administrators bypass. Changes need a client refresh.

items.name: Read permission
items.where: Profile column permission Read: Allowed / Not Allowed
items.notes: Denied users see a lock icon and asterisks on forms and views.

items.name: Read unmasked permission
items.where: Profile column permission Read unmasked: All Records / One record / Not Allowed
items.notes: Applies when a masking rule is set.

items.name: Update permission
items.where: Profile column permission Update: Allowed / Not Allowed

items.name: Create permission
items.where: Profile column permission Create: Allowed / Not Allowed

items.name: Columns that cannot be secured
items.notes: Not securable: virtual-table columns, lookups, formula columns, primary name columns, system columns (createdon, modifiedon, statecode, statuscode).

items.name: Calculated/prompt column exposure
items.notes: Secure both the source and dependent calculated/prompt columns.

items.name: One-to-many / many-to-one relationship (lookup)
items.where: OneToManyRelationshipMetadata (ReferencedEntity, ReferencingEntity, ReferencingAttribute); solution Other/Relationships/<table>.xml <EntityRelationship> with <EntityRelationshipType>OneToMany
items.notes: Adding a lookup column creates a 1:N relationship; N:1 is the same relationship seen from the referencing table (learn-relationship-metadata). Rows can relate to rows of another table or the same table (learn-relationships). Subgrids and associated views name the relationship (RelationshipName).

items.name: Many-to-many relationship
items.notes: Uses an intersect table with no custom columns and no lookup columns or behaviours to configure (learn-nn-relationships).

items.name: Cascade on delete of the referenced row
items.notes: Valid options for Delete are Cascade, RemoveLink and Restrict (learn-cascading). RemoveLink clears the lookup on the related rows; Restrict prevents deleting the referenced row while related rows exist.

items.name: Cascade on assign, share, unshare and reparent
items.notes: Valid options for each of these actions are Active, Cascade, NoCascade and UserOwned (learn-cascading).

items.name: Alternate key
items.notes: Allowed column types: Decimal, Whole Number, Single line of text, Date Time, Lookup, Option Set. No field-level security; at most 900 bytes and 16 columns; max 10 keys per table; values containing / < > * % & : \ ? + break retrieve/update/upsert by key; not supported on virtual tables; index built asynchronously (EntityKeyIndexStatus), ReactivateEntityKey after failure.

items.name: Plug-in modifies the write (input parameter mutation before the operation)
items.where: PreOperation (stage 20) step that changes attributes of the Target entity in InputParameters before the platform writes
items.notes: Learn: in the PreOperation stage a plug-in can modify the Target before the data is written; changes in PostOperation do not reach the record.

items.name: Email text control
items.schemaRef: classid harvested from exported main forms of the connected environment (the FormXml schema defines the attribute, Learn lists no GUIDs)
items.notes: Harvested value; the generator cites it.

items.name: URL text control
items.schemaRef: classid harvested from exported main forms of the connected environment (the FormXml schema defines the attribute, Learn lists no GUIDs)
items.notes: Harvested value; the generator cites it.

items.name: Phone text control
items.schemaRef: classid harvested from exported main forms of the connected environment (the FormXml schema defines the attribute, Learn lists no GUIDs)
items.notes: Harvested value; the generator cites it.

items.name: Ticker symbol control
items.schemaRef: classid harvested from exported main forms of the connected environment (the FormXml schema defines the attribute, Learn lists no GUIDs)
items.notes: Harvested value; the generator cites it.

items.name: Status reason control
items.schemaRef: classid harvested from exported main forms of the connected environment (the FormXml schema defines the attribute, Learn lists no GUIDs)
